Established in 1910 and located in scenic Central New York. We are proud to celebrate over 100 years and three generations of service. Our family-run practice has nine doctors, including a full-time board-certified surgeon, a part-time board-certified radiologist, and a part-time board-certified cardiologist. We also offer canine & feline rehabilitation, laser therapy, grooming, as well as hospice and palliative care. Paw Talk is Stack Veterinary Hospital's weekly radio show. Two of our doctors answer listener questions on pet health every Sunday between 10-11AM on Newsradio 570 WSYR (106.9 FM)

We are proud to have been AAHA-accredited since 1957, and Cat Friendly Certified. Our state-of-the-art facility offers:
•	Digital radiography
•	Ultrasound
•	Cardiology
•	A cat-only waiting area
•	Eight exam rooms
•	A fully-equipped dental suite
•	A spacious surgery suite
